entry.content: SummaryWith default flags, a pattern that contains several * wildcards takes polynomial time, O(n^k) for k stars, to reject a crafted file name. The pattern is an ordinary developer constant such as *_*_*_*_*.csv; only the string being matched comes from the attacker. A 255-byte file name (the maximum on common filesystems) takes 73 s with fnmatch.fnmatch() and 86 s with glob.globmatch(). entry.content: Summarysvg2rlg() expands <use> references without any limit on the total number of expansions. Only direct cycles are rejected (CircularRefError). A group containing N <use> elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. entry.content: Concurrent surfacing RPC failures can trigger more than one reconnect for the same dirty session, and cancellation during a post-reconnect retry can leave the replacement session reusable despite an interrupted protocol exchange. The private fix introduces monotonic session generations, one shielded shared reconnect flight per dirty generation, and generation-aware cancellation handling across search, access-count, and scratch RPCs. entry.title: [memtomem-stm] memtomem-stm: Surfaced memory data can escape the Markdown compatibility boundary | Security Advisory for Python packages hosted at PyPI.org
entry.summary: Untrusted long-term and working-memory fields can introduce Markdown or HTML-compatible structure into the surfaced-memory envelope. A crafted memory may create misleading structural boundaries or vis
entry.content: Untrusted long-term and working-memory fields can introduce Markdown or HTML-compatible structure into the surfaced-memory envelope. A crafted memory may create misleading structural boundaries or visually conceal content. The private fix serializes every untrusted field as inert single-line data, validates copyable memory identifiers, and pins an explicit untrusted-data preamble. Ordinary natural-language persuasion remains a residual model-level risk.Referenceshttps://github.com/memtomem/memto

entry.title: [aedes] Aedes has Uncaught Exception and Uncontrolled Resource Consumption | Security Advisory for JavaScript packages hosted at npmjs.com
entry.summary: SummaryA remote Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability, allows any remote client to cause a complete crash of the Aedes MQTT broker process. This is achieved by sending a specially crafted MQTT message
entry.content: SummaryA remote Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability, allows any remote client to cause a complete crash of the Aedes MQTT broker process. This is achieved by sending a specially crafted MQTT message (via PUBLISH or SUBSCRIBE), or by setting a Will message with such a topic, containing a highly recursive topic string (e.g., with thousands of '/' delimiters).
